recommendations.issue: Inconsistent kitchen preparation or declining freshness of ingredients leading to poor food quality.
recommendations.action: Implement strict kitchen standard operating procedures (SOPs), mandate daily freshness checks for all ingredients, and conduct mandatory retraining for line cooks.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant reduction in negative food quality reviews and improved dish consistency.

recommendations.issue: Menu items priced higher than the perceived value delivered by food quality.
recommendations.action: Audit current menu item costs and perceived value, and either improve portion sizes/ingredient quality or adjust pricing downwards to match customer expectations.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved customer perception of value and a decrease in pricing-related complaints.
